title: Design System: On the Way — Ninja Arena

display.purpose: Uppercase hero titles; Black Italic 900. Compact and desktop overrides are documented in DESIGN.md.

body.purpose: Plain upright exercise cues and instructions.

movement-label.purpose: System-font movement names, paired with smaller station labels.

countdown.purpose: Tabular rectangular player countdown; smaller beside a demo.

motion.name: course-drift
motion.purpose: Three bounded elements share one slow peripheral drift; translate(-24px, 16px) to translate(24px, -16px).

motion.name: button-transition
motion.purpose: Primary hover and press response; press scale .985.

motion.name: motion-gate
motion.value: manual pause || prefers-reduced-motion || document.hidden || active workout
motion.purpose: Any condition freezes course motion, including paused workouts. Reduce Motion removes all transitions and animations and hides the motion toggle.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Full-width red Start, Pause, Resume and return action.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary">Start workout <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m8 5 10 7-10 7Z"/></svg></button>

components.name: Secondary text action
components.description: Bare minimum · 20s squats appears on every overview, including custom routines. It replaces the former one-minute shortcut: five seconds prep and twenty seconds of bodyweight squats, no rest or rep target. It never changes saved settings or the selected overview; completion and End return there. End workout uses the same quiet text treatment.

components.name: Header icon action
components.description: A 44px target for the background-motion or back control.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon" aria-label="Back to workout"><svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m9 5 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>

components.name: Time choices
components.description: Native radio labels; cyan selects the duration.

components.name: Circuit row
components.description: Number, instruction and aligned dose with a pale-ground pixel sprite in production. Default At home shows three 20-second movement rows and the explicit note “5 sec prep · 20 sec rest after each exercise.” Morning retains its five movements, kids shows all five phases, and custom routines show every saved step.

components.name: Session selector
components.description: Morning / At home / With kids switch the visible workout directly. Default Morning places Time beside Edit session in the metadata row; custom Morning hides Time. All three session settings persist independently in the existing version-1 configuration, with home optional for compatibility. Completion and End return to the selected overview, including after Bare minimum.

components.name: Session editor field
components.description: Native exercise select and numeric seconds field with a 48px touch target and cyan keyboard focus. At home exposes all seven phases: 5 seconds prep, then 20 seconds each of kettlebell squats, rest, incline push-ups, rest, kettlebell swings and rest (125 seconds total). Narrow phones stack the exercise above seconds/removal.
components.html: <label class="ds-editor-field">Seconds<input type="number" min="1" max="600" step="1" value="20"></label>

components.name: Preparation and rest
components.description: Teal break state with an explicit phase heading, next movement and station, and current-phase countdown. Production pairs the timer with the next movement’s pixel demo; final rest omits it. New kettlebell squat/swing strips match the incumbent character, while incline push-ups reuse the platform sprite. Finishing or ending restores the selected overview.

narrative.overview:
Ninja Arena gives a small personal workout the presence of an athlete’s arena entrance. Midnight navy, signal red, ice cyan and oversized condensed type carry the energy; clear instructions and familiar controls keep the operation calm and direct.

Cropped course rails move at the edge of the view. The foreground is a disciplined reading and action layer: aligned numbered stations, exact quantities, one primary action, and matching pixel-art movement demos. The identity is athletic without competition, scores or extra tasks.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight navy with white reading text, red actions and cyan station markers.
Black italic display type paired with upright condensed numerals and system body text.
Flat, aligned movement rows and rectangular timing panels.
One slow course drift that stops throughout active and paused workouts.

rules.name: The Action Color Rule
rules.body: Red identifies the primary action; cyan identifies station order, selection, focus and active progress.

rules.name: The Immediate Start Rule
rules.body: Show the workout and its single primary Start action without adding an introductory step.

rules.name: The Exercise Stillness Rule
rules.body: Decorative course motion stays frozen throughout active and paused workouts and yields to manual pause, hidden tabs and Reduce Motion.

dos: **Do** retain the large athletic display face and the quieter system-font instructions.
**Do** align station numbers, movement labels and right-aligned doses in one continuous list.
**Do** keep the normal routine at 8 push-ups, 8 knee raises, a 10-second hang, a 10-second hold and 8 squats.
**Do** keep focus visible, secondary text tinted, tap targets generous and short screens scrollable.
**Do** preserve the existing sprites on pale square grounds and the one-primary-action flow.
donts: **Don't** restore the superseded lime-and-forest palette or white grouped-card identity.
**Don't** add photos, new raster decoration, floating movement cards, shadows or competitive metrics.
**Don't** animate the course during an active or paused workout.
**Don't** replace the rectangular countdown and bottom progress strip with a circular dial.
